title: From entropy waves to vortex sheets for the Euler equations
summary: We construct piecewise smooth solutions of the full compressible Euler equations that evolve from entropy waves into vortex sheets while retaining a strictly positive Taylor jump. For every integer $κ\geq1$, we obtain solutions satisfying initial material compatibility for pressure and velocity through order $κ$, whose tangential velocity jump has a nonzero leading term of order $t^{κ+1}$. These solutions are periodic in the tangential variables and admit a smooth realization in a slab with impermeable walls.
